messages.subject: Data extraction first day
parts:
Dear all

I have an issue with extracting the data of the first day. Participants had to wear the Axivity for 3 months. Unfortunately, the battery only lasts around 14 days, so after these 14 days, they received a new Axivity (always around 10 in the morning, because we had movement sessions together and I wanted that specific PA-data). 

If I run the script, the first day is not extracted and I don't know why specifically (start time = 10 am, wearing time = 10 am). Normally, if data_masking_strategy = 1, hrs.del.start = 0, hrs.del.end = 0, he should include all the data from start to end?

 Maybe someone is able to help me with this? Below you can find my script.


g.shell.GGIR( ### ==========================================================
      # General parameters #ADJUST PARTICIPANT NUMBER
      ### ==========================================================
      mode=c(1,2,3,4,5),
      datadir = 
      outputdir = 
      studyname = 
      overwrite = TRUE,
      do.report = c(2,4,5),
      nonwear_approach = "2023",
      ### ==========================================================
      # Part 1 parameters
      ### ==========================================================
      windowsizes = c(5,900,3600),
      do.cal = TRUE,
      do.enmo = TRUE,
      do.anglez = TRUE,
      chunksize = 1,
      printsummary = TRUE,
      ### ==========================================================
      # Part 2 parameters #ADJUST MVPATRESHOLD 
      ### ==========================================================
      data_masking_strategy = 1,
      hrs.del.start = 0,
      hrs.del.end = 0,
      ilevels = c(seq(0,400,by=50),8000),
      mvpathreshold = c(104),
      ### =========================================================
      # Part 4 parameters #ADJUST TRESHOLD CUTPOINTS (Sanders 2019, GENEavtic/Axivity, non-dominant wrist)
      ### ==========================================================
      treshold.lig = c(57),
      treshold.mod = c(104),
      boutcriter = 0.8,
      boutcriter.in = 0.9,
      boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
      boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8,
      boutdur.in = c(10,20,30),
      boutdur.lig = c(1,5,10),
      boutdur.mvpa = c(1,5,10),
      visualreport = TRUE,
      )

Thank you for your time!

Kind regards,
Evelien Iliano

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Data extraction first day
parts: the first day is not extracted

Which specific GGIR output are you referring to? In GGIR part2 csv reports we exclude the first day if it does not have enough valid hours, see parameter includedaycrit. Further, GGIR by default always starts at a round number of 15 minutes. For example, if your recording starts at 9:50 you will see results from 10:00 onward. We do this to standardise long epoch size (used as resolution for nonwear detection) and timing in a day.

Another reason why the start of a recording may look strange is if you did not specify the timezone and the data was collected in a different timezone.

Best,

Vincent
